recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血中並排可見核摺疊、細胞質灰藍的單核球與不成熟單核細胞，以及核分葉異常的嗜中性球；兒童單核球系列增生合併顆粒球異形變化，符合幼年型骨髓單核球性白血病（JMML）。
features: Monocytes with convoluted, ring-like or folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Round mononuclear cell with coarse clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (immature monocyte or lymphocyte)
Neutrophil with abnormally segmented, clumped nuclear lobes and hypogranular cytoplasm
Red cells with stomatocyte-like central pallor and occasional elongated forms
Small platelet fragments in background; no blasts identified
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows several myelomonocytic cells in a row: monocytes with folded or ring-shaped nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm, a round mononuclear cell with clumped chromatin, and a neutrophil with irregular clumped lobes and reduced granulation. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with monocytosis with dysplastic granulocytic features, suggestive of juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in a young child.

ddx.vs: CMML shows the same monocytosis and granulocytic dysplasia but affects older adults, so patient age and genetics separate it from JMML.
Reactive monocytes lack accompanying granulocytic dysplasia and the persistent monocytosis, splenomegaly and RAS-pathway mutations of JMML.
Morphology is indistinguishable; the germline PTPN11 status and spontaneous resolution in infancy distinguish it from JMML.
